business_problem: The consultancy needed a QA operating model that could support enterprise-wide digital transformation while lowering testing cost, improving governance, and reducing downstream defects.
solution_summary: Capgemini served as QA partner for a big-four consultancy's enterprise transformation by implementing a SMART QA platform built on ADMnext solutions and powered by Cognitive QA. Instead of treating testing as a manual downstream activity, the platform centralizes service cataloging, governance templates, SLA dashboards, and a command-center operating model so quality signals are visible across the delivery lifecycle. Automation-led testing is combined with AI, BOTs, and RPA integrations to reduce repetitive work and expand hybrid, pay-per-use delivery. Cognitive QA provides the intelligence layer for customized dashboarding, testing metrics, and smarter quality operations, while monthly assessments and stakeholder cadences keep the platform evolving with the customer's broader modernization program. The result is a reusable QA operating stack that shifts quality work left, standardizes reporting, and lowers the total cost of assurance across a changing application landscape.
